notes: Created via direct Kibana saved_objects _import API (kibana-dashboards skill not installed; newer POST /api/dashboards/dashboard/{id} API returns 404 on this Serverless instance).
ES_API_KEY (not KIBANA_API_KEY) is required for /api/data_views and _import endpoints on Serverless.
Data views used: gp-dv-timeline (gamepulse-game-timeline, created this session), 18dd83e8-6f88-474f-b434-a4b6c14a04a2 (metrics-gamepulse.* wildcard).
gamepulse-game-timeline data view created this session (ID: gp-dv-timeline, timeFieldName: session_start).
gamepulse.game.name has text/keyword ambiguity across backing indices — not usable in ES|QL STATS BY even with date filter. Dashboard uses gp-dv-timeline (game_name keyword) instead.
gamepulse.summary.bottleneck_dominant is null in 2026-04-12 session docs (field present in game-timeline as keyword).
Navigation bar placeholders: Games, Hardware, Environment, Engine, Compare dashboards not yet built. Update nav bar markdown when IDs are known.
Sessions link points to Session Deep-Dive dashboard (b68f1178-6923-4e92-819b-33eb595197a9).
Environment changes panel shows raw per-session env values (driver, kernel, proton, avg_fps) — delta/LAG computation not possible in ES without a Transform. Noted in CLAUDE.md.
All games table: 'Total Play (s)' column is duration_s SUM in seconds. Kibana format: use 'duration' formatter if desired.
count() for Sessions column in all-games table counts gamepulse-game-timeline documents per game (1 doc = 1 session).
All field paths validated from live gamepulse-game-timeline data before building.
schema_notes: Kibana NDJSON _import format: panelsJSON is an array of embedded panel objects (not separate lens saved objects).
references array at dashboard level must duplicate all references from all embedded panels.
lnsDatatable visualization.columns: bucket columns use isTransposed=true, metric columns use isTransposed=false.
last_value operationType requires params.sortField — used 'session_start' throughout.
max operationType on a date field produces dataType='date' column.
count operationType has no sourceField — isBucketed=false, dataType=number.
markdown panel type: embeddableConfig.markdown contains the content string.
